unit_label: BRBL C U06: Prepare magistrate assistance and distinguish management consequences from loss-of-office compensation

facts.statement: Section14 requires written request and stated authorised-officer affidavit;30-day order period and qualified recorded-reason extension up to60aggregate. Section15 management effects/restoration with controlling-equity proviso;16 excludes loss-office compensation but preserves other recoverables.

payload.title: Assistance and takeover require their own records
payload.core_explanation_md:
A section 14 request is supported by the authorised officer affidavit addressing the specified claim, valid security, limitation, default, classification, notice, objection treatment and compliance facts. The authority must satisfy itself on that record. The thirty-day order period has a qualified extension, for recorded reasons beyond control, within sixty days in aggregate; this does not certify the outcome of a real proceeding.

Management takeover under section 15 has statutory publication and governance effects. Restoration after full realisation has the stated controlling-equity conversion exception. Section 16 bars the specified loss-of-office compensation but preserves other recoverable money claims. Do not turn one compensation exclusion into extinction of every amount owed to a displaced director or manager.

self_check.prompt_text: Does the loss-of-office compensation bar erase every other recoverable money claim?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Section16 separately preserves other recoverables.

payload.stem_md: A section14 application supplies only the loan balance and omits the statutory affidavit compliance facts. Which improvement is required?

options.text_md: Treat the balance figure as proof of every required fact
options.explanation_md: The statutory declaration covers more than the outstanding amount.

options.text_md: Replace the affidavit with an undated internal collection target
options.explanation_md: An internal target does not satisfy the described affidavit requirements.

options.text_md: Provide the authorised-officer affidavit addressing the specified security, limitation, notice and compliance facts
options.explanation_md: The authority must consider the required statutory record.

options.text_md: Assume the authority has already taken possession merely because the request was sent
options.explanation_md: Request and completed possession are different events.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The authority must consider the required statutory record.

payload.stem_md: A displaced manager has one claim for loss of office and a separate otherwise recoverable money claim. Which section16 distinction matters?

options.text_md: The compensation exclusion does not itself extinguish the distinct otherwise recoverable amount
Every sum owed to a manager is automatically cancelled
options.explanation_md: This enlarges the exclusion beyond its stated scope.

options.text_md: The compensation exclusion guarantees a fresh management appointment
options.explanation_md: No such appointment right follows from the distinction.

options.text_md: A separate debt becomes compensation merely because its holder was a manager
options.explanation_md: The character of the claim must be assessed rather than assumed.
